## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what makes it hard or impossible today?

## Proposed solution

What you would like bgsd to do. If it touches the pipeline, say which stage
(classify, Loop 1, merge, Loop 2, review gate, etc.) or which command
(`/bgsd-sesh`, `/bgsd-queue`, ...).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they fall short.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps: examples, links, or how it fits the "no silent green"
and never-write-production invariants.
